summary.text: Dale DeVon is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 5, assumed office on November 7, 2012, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Alex Wait (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Dale DeVon's professional experience includes owning and operating DeVon Custom Homes.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists DeVon as chair of the Family, Children and Human Affairs Committee and a member of the Utilities, Energy and Telecommunications Committee.
